PRIVATE OCCASIONS / GUEST ARRIVALS

A memorable evening deserves a journey planned with the same care as the event. Martinez Logistics offers transportation for special occasions, with the timing, party size and return arrangements considered before the day arrives.

Whether you are coordinating guests, attending a performance or planning a private celebration, share the actual venue and the complete sequence of stops. An event charter is arranged around those details. Confirm vehicle capacity, duration, waiting and the final quote directly; an hourly listing does not automatically define every event arrangement.

01

Before the occasion

Give the venue address, the time guests should arrive and any venue instructions for vehicles. If guests are staying at several hotels, identify each pickup clearly.

02

Together, where appropriate

A shared journey can simplify guest coordination. Discuss the Sprinter category for groups, with seating, luggage and accessibility needs checked before confirming a vehicle.

03

The return, considered

Agree on the end-of-event meeting point and expected pickup time. If the finish may move, discuss how updates, waiting and any additional time will be handled.

A SEAMLESS START

A few details.
A better journey.

Bring these details to your reservation or inquiry so the service can be arranged around your plans.

  1. Venue and event date
  2. Required arrival and return times
  3. Guest count and pickup addresses
  4. Waiting, luggage and access requirements

BEFORE YOU TRAVEL

Useful details.

How early should I arrange event transport?

Contact the company as soon as the venue and date are known. Vehicle availability and the event plan must be confirmed; browsing a category does not hold a vehicle.

Can guests be collected from different hotels?

Provide each hotel address, the guest count at each stop and the time everyone must arrive. Additional stops and vehicles should be included in the confirmed itinerary.

What happens if the event finishes later?

Discuss that possibility before the event. Waiting, schedule changes and additional time depend on availability and the terms confirmed by the company.
